item.description: He sat on the vault steps with the staff across his knees, and the banking hall was full, and nobody said anything.

item.title: Chapter 277: Deaf

item.description: They argued about the name for nine days, and then Xiaoyu settled it by accident.

item.description: They could not move her.

item.title: Chapter 271: Light the Lamp
item.description: The stone was too hot to touch, and he touched it anyway.

item.title: Chapter 270: The Silence of the Hollow Bell
item.description: In three days, two hundred and fourteen of the chosen came down the road, and the Hollow Bell did not sing once.

item.title: Chapter 269: Chosen
item.description: "You did it again," he said.

item.description: They heard it before they saw it, and then everyone on Blue Star heard it, and nobody could say afterward what it had sounded like except that it was the most beautiful thing they had ever heard and…

item.title: Chapter 267: Down the Thread
item.description: Summer went, and the Candle's children learned to wear shoes.

item.description: The first person from another world to stand on Blue Star came down a road of light onto the north wall of Lingzhou at five in the morning, and the first thing she did was look at the sky and not say…

item.title: Chapter 265: Again
item.description: The boy who came off the road first was called Tam, and on the third day, he asked to be taken to the stone.

item.title: Chapter 264: Burning Low
item.description: The cousins went up into the Eighth Candle on the second night, down the keeper's eye, a hundred thousand of them, and the first thing they did when they reached the arrays was apologize.

item.title: Chapter 263: Position Four Thousand and Eleven
item.description: The Listener-Captain of the Eighth Candle did not speak again for nine hours, and when she did, she asked to be taught.

item.title: Chapter 262: The Eighth Candle
item.description: It talked for three hours before anyone answered it, and Seed listened to every second.

item.title: Chapter 261: Loud
item.description: His mother knew before they were through the bronze door.

item.title: Chapter 260: What the Quiet Know
item.description: Ichiro talked all night.
